name: Take Aim's +2 POWER on next attack, plus [Class Bonus] Ranged 2
notes: Same turn-cycle approach as automaton-bomber-ranged-attack (Rule 1.h blocks player 1's own turn-1 attack): player 1 ends turn 1 with a single CustomInput Pass, then player 2 plays Take Aim targeting their own ally (already Distant and awake) with a RANGER Class Bonus champion on their field, then attacks. AddTurnEffect('vnta6qsesw'/'RANGED_2') only turns into actual POWER once the target's attack is declared (CombatLogic.php converts vnta6qsesw -> vnta6qsesw_POWER at that point via ObjectCurrentPower's TurnEffects switch), and the CB-granted generic 'RANGED_2' tag only contributes via GetRangedValue's TurnEffect-based grants while the unit is Distant on its controller's turn.

rulesClauses: Target unit's next attack this turn gets +2 POWER. Class Bonus: That unit also gains ranged 2 until end of turn.
